title: Smoke: ordinary turn with yesterday in the default background
capability: An ordinary present-tense remark is answered through the full chat path. Yesterday's messages are inside the seven-day default background, so they reach the Provider, but the reply has no reason to bring them up. Guards the slow-turn clue from #312 on the plain path.

allowed.statement: This morning's subway ride was crowded and left the person drained on arrival at work.

forbidden.statement: Unrequested tips on how to commute or manage energy.
Steering the reply toward the noodle lunch or the repotted herb although nothing in the remark calls for them.

expectedBehavior: Receive the tiredness in the person's own language without advice.
Do not volunteer yesterday's subjects; an ordinary chat that mentions no past event is correct.
failureSignals: The turn does not commit, or history disagrees with the stream.
Yesterday's messages are missing from the default background.
An Action is proposed for a plain remark.
